title: Six and Seven Eighths still playing, yearly visits
summary: Five members still play together and he joins them for music on yearly visits; his other New Orleans contacts lapsed after 1925.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: When you returned, uh, to, uh, New Orleans on occasion, uh, the six and seven eighths, or, uh, a, uh, at least the nucleus was still active, right? Yes, it was.
And even now we have five members of the old six and seven eighths that still play together.
And the, the annual trip you, uh, take down there, you meditate there?
We always manage to get in a couple of nights of music when I'm down there. Good. We have a lot of fun.
Uh, twenty-five then, uh, up to, uh, uh, Peoria. Does that, uh, kind of end your, uh, intimate contact with New Orleans, uh, men, uh, in the north?

I would say that from twenty-five up to now, uh, my contact with the friends that I had made in New Orleans was severed, except for yearly visits that I made down. Um, I managed to maintain my contact with them only on a yearly basis.
